backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor with user profiles, cars, race data, teams, holidays, and authorization mixin plus comparison functions for leaderboard sorting.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme variables and base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the root React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router navigation and wraps protected admin routes with AdminGuard.
frontend/src/assets/generatedAssets.ts: Exports paths to generated asset packs including logo, cars, trails, and banners.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: Displays a styled access-denied message with a return-to-dashboard button.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAudit: Mock audit log component showing sample admin action entries in a scrollable card.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Allows admin route access for authenticated users with profiles; otherwise shows denial or loading state.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal prompting new authenticated users to create a profile with username and display name.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Layout component with header, navigation, and authentication handling using Internet Identity and admin checks.
frontend/src/components/race/carModelPro: Defines detailed 3D and 2D dimension profiles for various car models used in rendering components.
frontend/src/components/race/CarViewer3D: Renders an animated 3D car model in Three.js using profile-based geometry and customizable colors.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackCarMar: Draws a 2D top‑down car marker based on model profile and color for track visualization.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackVisual: Displays a horizontal race track with moving car markers for player and optional ghost opponents.
frontend/src/components/race/WordZoneInd: Shows the user's current typing zone and target word count in compact or full card format.
frontend/src/hooks/useActiveCar.ts: Manages the active car ID in localStorage with getter and setter hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to check if the caller is admin or retrieve their user role via backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useEconomy.ts: Provides mutations for granting TRP coins and completing races, with related cache invalidation; most features depend on the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGhostOpponents.ts: Stubbed hook returning no ghost opponents due to disabled backend support.
frontend/src/hooks/useHolidays.ts: Defines disabled holiday queries and mutations, returning empty data or errors until backend support exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context and provider for login, identity management, and status handling using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInventory.ts: Fetches the current user's inventory based on their Internet Identity principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeaderboards.ts: Stubbed leaderboard query hook that returns empty data with querying disabled.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotd.ts: Returns a static MOTD string as a placeholder with no backend integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides profile, inventory, car catalog, and admin role queries and mutations tied to the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeams.ts: Contains disabled team-related queries and mutations, returning empty data or errors pending backend support.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/adminCommandParser.ts: Parses admin CLI-style commands for creating titles, setting MOTD, adding text, and granting coins.
frontend/src/lib/raceMetrics.ts: Utility functions to compute WPM, accuracy, and race metrics from character counts and time.
frontend/src/lib/raceTextGeneration.ts: Provides functions to determine effective WPM, store last race WPM, and generate race text based on word pools and WPM-derived word zones.
frontend/src/lib/wordZones.ts: Defines WPM-to-word-zone mappings and selects target word counts based on ranges or exact values.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPag: Placeholder admin page for managing banner designs with a simple coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarsPage.t: Placeholder admin page for car inventory management with a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarTemplat: Placeholder admin page for managing car templates with a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCustomizeI: Admin navigation page linking to customization sections like cars, templates, banners, trails, nitros, and titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminEconomyToo: Admin interface for granting TRP Coins to users with validation, feedback, and additional economy info.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomePage.t: Main admin dashboard linking to management sections such as texts, customization, economy, MOTD, and admin management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManagement: Admin page for granting or revoking admin rights by validating a Principal ID and calling promote or revoke mutations.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMotdPage.t: Placeholder admin page for configuring the message of the day.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminNitrosPage: Placeholder admin page for managing Nitro effects.
Placeholder admin page for managing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTitlesPage: Placeholder admin page for managing player titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTrailsPage: Placeholder admin page for managing trail effects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUpdateAssi: Admin page that parses natural-language commands and executes supported actions like granting TRP coins.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TextDemoPage.ts: Placeholder page for demonstrating text-related features.
frontend/src/pages/CustomizePage.tsx: Displays customization options for cars and other cosmetics, showing owned items and allowing active car selection.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with racing, leaderboard, and team links, adapting UI for authenticated and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardsPage.tsx: Shows placeholder leaderboard categories with tabbed navigation for speed, accuracy, and combined rankings.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's profile details and stats with loading and unauthenticated states handled.
frontend/src/pages/RaceHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a placeholder race history page requiring login and indicating upcoming backend support.
frontend/src/pages/RaceLobbyPage.tsx: Displays the race lobby, showing word zone previews and buttons to start solo, ghost, or practice races, handling login state and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/RacePage.tsx: Runs the active race, generating text, tracking typing progress and metrics, storing results, and navigating to the results page on completion.
frontend/src/pages/RaceResultsPage.tsx: Shows post-race metrics such as WPM, accuracy, and time, pulling data from session storage and warning when results aren’t saved.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Displays purchasable car models and variants, allowing logged-in users to select colors and buy cars while showing ownership status.
frontend/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx: Provides admin‑controlled seasonal theme tabs and a holiday management interface with add and remove actions.
frontend/src/pages/TeamDetailsPage.tsx: Displays detailed info for a selected team, including membership status, balance, and founder identification, with loading and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx: Lists all teams and provides a dialog to create a new team, including balance checks and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, plugins, and custom colors, fonts, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, pending requests, and overall project state.
